record.name: Maja Popović
record.title: Associate Professor
record.bio: Maja Popović is an Associate Professor in the Department of Biomedical Engineering at the Faculty of Technical Sciences, University of Novi Sad. Her research focuses on biomedical signal processing and wearable sensing systems, with a particular emphasis on cardiac monitoring, arrhythmia detection, and the reduction of false alarms in ambulatory ECG devices. She develops embedded signal-processing algorithms suitable for deployment on resource-constrained microcontrollers and wearable patch sensors. Professor Popović leads the HEARTWATCH project, which investigates remote cardiac monitoring solutions for long-term atrial fibrillation screening. She has authored multiple peer-reviewed publications on ECG classification, motion-artifact suppression, and accelerometer-based activity recognition. She is actively seeking industrial PhD co-supervision arrangements and joint applied research projects with technology companies.
